title: Connplex Zoning Studio — Reconstructed and Validated Floor Boundaries v1

regions.label: BASEMENT FLOOR PLAN
evidence: Framing rectangle [278F] (122.08 x 117.09 ft, 14294.79 sq ft) is a sheet title frame and rejected as a usable floor boundary.

BOUNDARY_RECONSTRUCTION_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: No continuous closed exterior wall enclosure exists in the CAD source geometry. Openings for vehicular access / shopping colonnades leave perimeter unclosed.

regions.label: FIRST FLOOR PLAN
evidence: Source handle [6A8] on layer 'wall' forms a verified single closed polyline.
Gross enclosed area: 5242.04 sq ft, perimeter: 291.39 ft, aspect ratio: 1.25.
All structural columns and interior rooms lie within this boundary.
Contains internal cores (fire stairs on 'stair', lift shafts, ducts); marked PENDING_EXCLUSIONS until non-occupiable cores are excluded.

regions.label: Cinema Zoning Studio — Option 1 (Lower Layout / Screens 1–5)
evidence: Treated as an independent zoning option.
Outer drawing frame [8285A] spans multiple options and is strictly rejected as a floor boundary.
Schedule and area calculation table region is excluded.
Reconstructed 46 closed loops from wall geometry.
Detected 6 auditorium screen shells ranging from 1,113 to 1,306 sq ft.
No continuous single closed exterior boundary encloses the option; perimeter is open to mall corridors and public entries.
usable_planning_boundary is set to null to avoid fabricating a false outer envelope.
